package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    Map<String, Object> propsAsArray,
    Map<String, Object> propsAsTrue,
    Map<String, Object> propsAsZero,
    List<Object> itemsFalse,
    Map<String, Object> addlArray,
    Map<String, Object> addlNull,
    Map<String, Object> patternEmpty,
    Map<String, Object> patternFalsy,
    Object typeNumber,
    Object typeMixedArray,
    String requiredBad
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("propsAsArray"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("propsAsTrue"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("propsAsZero"),
            (List<Object>) map.get("itemsFalse"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("addlArray"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("addlNull"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("patternEmpty"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("patternFalsy"),
            (Object) map.get("typeNumber"),
            (Object) map.get("typeMixedArray"),
            (String) map.get("requiredBad")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("propsAsArray", propsAsArray);
        map.put("propsAsTrue", propsAsTrue);
        map.put("propsAsZero", propsAsZero);
        map.put("itemsFalse", itemsFalse);
        map.put("addlArray", addlArray);
        map.put("addlNull", addlNull);
        map.put("patternEmpty", patternEmpty);
        map.put("patternFalsy", patternFalsy);
        map.put("typeNumber", typeNumber);
        map.put("typeMixedArray", typeMixedArray);
        map.put("requiredBad", requiredBad);
        return map;
    }
}
